capabilities: collapse all subfolders when a parent folder is collapsed
keep only one folder branch expanded via exclusive accordion mode
toggle each feature independently in settings
extras: Both features default to Off and must be enabled in Settings; requires Obsidian 0.12.0 or later.
problem: Collapsing a parent folder in Obsidian's file explorer leaves subfolders expanded, so the sidebar stays cluttered.
summary: File explorer helper that collapses all child folders when you collapse a parent folder, with an optional exclusive accordion mode.
